backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Kids Fun App backend, defining all core data types (UserProfile, GameProgress, Events, Chat, Rewards, etc.) and mixing in storage, access control, and user approval modules with constants for spin cooldown and trophy logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two SpinWheelPage features — cooldown countdown timer with disabled button and points-only virtual pet mutation — to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable implementation details of pages, hooks, components, and styles across the app.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React frontend, mounting the app into a `#root` div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that handles authentication-based routing, imports all pages and game components, defines a centralized trial game allowlist, and gates access to restricted pages for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AchievementCeleb: Portal-based achievement celebration component that renders confetti or fireworks animations with a message overlay, exposed via a global `triggerAchievementCelebration` function with a queue for pre-mount events.
Wrapper component that checks if the current user is approved and either renders children or displays a pending-approval card with a button to request admin approval.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/AvatarP: An interactive 3D avatar preview component that renders a CSS-based character figure with draggable rotation (mouse and touch), using avatar configuration to determine part styles via `getAvatarVariants`.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/AvatarR: An empty file with no content.
frontend/src/components/avatar3d/avatarV: Exports `getAvatarVariants`, which maps an `AvatarConfig` object to color, size, and type style descriptors for each avatar body part (body, head, hair, pants, headwear, shoes).
frontend/src/components/craft/YouTubeHel: An empty file with no content.
Displays animated encouraging feedback messages (with emojis) as toast-like overlays using a portal, with a global `showEmotionFeedback` function to trigger them from anywhere in the app.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper for game pages that renders a header with score/high-score display, sound toggle, trophy count, restart/back navigation buttons, and a pet upgrade dialog.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation links, login/logout button via Internet Identity, and an admin-only nav item shown conditionally.
frontend/src/components/HomepageFeatures: Marketing landing section that renders a grid of 20 feature cards (games, pets, stories, etc.) with icons and descriptions, plus a call-to-action button.
frontend/src/components/InstantMiniActiv: Interactive mini-game component offering three age-appropriate games (Tap & Smile for 1–3, Match & Move for 4–6, Challenge Mode for 7–12) with canvas-based rendering and game-loop logic.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/ArtsMu: A multi-step arts and music learning activity component supporting five mini-game types (color mixing, drawing, rhythm, instruments, creative prompts) with scoring, progress tracking, and optional text-to-speech.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Discov: A discovery-themed learning activity component with four game types (facts, how-it-works, world explorer, inventions) that includes quiz interactions, progress tracking, and optionally fetches invention stories from the backend.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Readin: A reading and vocabulary learning activity component supporting five game types (phonics, word builder, story comprehension, spelling, vocabulary) with step-by-step progression, scoring, and optional voice read-aloud.
frontend/src/components/learn-hub/Scienc: A React component that renders interactive science and nature lessons (weather, space, animals, plants) with step-by-step games, quizzes, and scoring. It supports multiple game types and awards stars upon completion.
frontend/src/components/MascotGuide.tsx: Floating mascot guide that shows contextual help messages per page with optional text-to-speech, auto-hiding after 8 seconds, and a button to re-show the guide.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A form component that collects a child's name and age (5–12) and saves their user profile using the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation, with toast notifications for success/failure.
frontend/src/content/craftDiyProjects.ts: A static data catalog of kid-friendly Craft & DIY projects across Art, Science, Cooking, and Seasonal categories, each with steps, materials, safety tips, and badge rewards.
frontend/src/content/seasonalEventStorie: A dataset of 20 kid-safe seasonal stories (ages 1–12) with full story text and narration scripts including pacing cues and sound direction for read-along use.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, returning an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for React, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a custom hook backed by DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePetReaction.ts: A custom React hook that manages a virtual pet's transient reaction state ('feed' or 'play'), auto-clearing it after 1.5 seconds and handling cleanup on unmount.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines shared TypeScript interfaces for the app's data models (profiles, pets, stories, games, events, etc.) and re-exports backend types, serving as the central type and query utility layer.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using oklch colors, and adds utility classes for neon glow effects and 3D avatar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page that displays platform statistics and allows admins to manage user statuses and feature restrictions, with access control guarding non-admin users.
frontend/src/pages/ArtGalleryPage.tsx: Art gallery page where authenticated users can upload images with a title and category, and browse both their own private artwork and publicly approved submissions.
frontend/src/pages/AvatarCreatorPage.tsx: Avatar creator page that lets users customize a 3D avatar by selecting body parts and colors, with randomize and save functionality backed by the user profile query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CertificatesPage.tsx: Certificates page that generates downloadable achievement certificates by rendering styled text and decorative borders onto an HTML canvas, with data pulled from the user's profile and certificate history.
frontend/src/pages/ChatModule.tsx: A static chat UI component with a contacts sidebar and message thread, using hardcoded mock data and local state for sending messages between predefined contacts.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: A real-time chat page that fetches online users and messages from the backend via React Query hooks, allowing authenticated users to send and receive direct messages.
frontend/src/pages/CraftDIYPage.tsx: A craft and DIY project browser with category filtering and a detail view, supporting marking projects as completed via a backend mutation that can award badges.
frontend/src/pages/CreativeFunHub.tsx: A hub page that displays navigation cards for four creative sub-modules (Interactive Shorts, Green Screen Fun, Karaoke Mode, Dance Challenge) and routes to them via a callback prop.
frontend/src/pages/DanceChallengePage.ts: An interactive dance challenge page where users select a routine, step through timed pose instructions, and optionally enable their webcam via a custom camera hook.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: The main dashboard that renders a searchable grid of module navigation cards, conditionally showing admin-only modules based on the authenticated user's role.
frontend/src/pages/EventCardCreator.tsx: A page component for creating customizable event greeting cards with template selection, font options, stickers, and borders, with download and share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/EventCardsPage.tsx: A page component for designing event cards with template and color selection, a live preview, and a gallery tab, supporting download of completed cards.
frontend/src/pages/EventsModule.tsx: A module page for managing events with a calendar view, event list showing days-until countdown, and a dialog form for creating new typed events (birthday, festival, school, etc.).
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: A full-featured events page that displays, adds, and deletes events with date picking and reminders, and shows auto-dismissing toast-style notifications for today's events fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/FeedbackPage.tsx: A feedback submission page that lets users select a feedback type, write a message, and optionally submit anonymously, while also displaying their previously submitted feedback using backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/FeedbackSystem.tsx: A feedback form page that lets users submit bug reports, feature requests, safety concerns, and general feedback with a satisfaction rating (happy/neutral/sad), title, description, and anonymous option.
frontend/src/pages/FunnyFartHub.tsx: An interactive sound board page featuring 30+ named fart sound buttons with distinct types (short, long, reverb, echo, wet, squeaky, meme, bassy, rhythmic), each synthesized via Web Audio API and displayed as colorful gradient cards.
frontend/src/pages/games/AmbulanceRescue: A timed keyboard-controlled mini-game where the player moves an ambulance to rescue randomly spawning patients within 60 seconds, tracking score and high score.
frontend/src/pages/games/BalloonPop.tsx: A click-based mini-game using requestAnimationFrame where balloons float upward and the player pops them for points, with bonus and penalty balloon types and a 60-second timer.
frontend/src/pages/games/BibbleAdventure: A simple platformer mini-game where the player moves and jumps to collect coins on platforms, with gravity simulation and game-over on falling off screen.
frontend/src/pages/games/BirthdayCakeDec: A creative mini-game where players click on a cake canvas to place emoji decorations, earning points per placement and a bonus on finishing.
frontend/src/pages/games/BirthdayCakeMak: A step-by-step cake-building mini-game where the player selects a base, flavor, and number of layers, earning points at each step and a bonus on completion.
frontend/src/pages/games/BossesLearnHabi: A canvas boss fight where the boss observes and learns the player's recent movement patterns to predict and aim projectiles, with the player shooting back via spacebar.
frontend/src/pages/games/BossFightOnly.t: A canvas-based boss fight game with three progressively harder bosses, featuring mechanics like reversed controls and gravity reversal; the player attacks by pressing space when close to the boss.
frontend/src/pages/games/CatGrapplingHoo: A canvas platformer where a cat uses a click-to-grapple hook mechanic with physics (gravity, friction, swing) to collect food items while avoiding patrolling enemies.
frontend/src/pages/games/CityMovingPlatf: A canvas platformer featuring sinusoidally oscillating, rotating platforms and a slowly rotating world, where the player jumps between platforms and scores points for horizontal distance traveled.
A canvas-based game where the player automatically moves toward a goal while the user controls enemies (selected via number keys) to block the path, with levels and score tracking.
frontend/src/pages/games/CronkerKontry.t: An idle/clicker resource management game where players build structures to generate gold, food, and power, with upgrades, achievements, and a prestige system.
frontend/src/pages/games/DelayedControls: A canvas-based puzzle game where player inputs are queued and executed with a 500ms delay, requiring the player to navigate obstacles and collect coins to reach a goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/DungeonJanitorS: A canvas-based game where the player moves around a dungeon to clean up debris (traps, monsters, cursed items) for points, with new debris spawning over time.
A space shooter game with an eclipse lighting theme where the player collects energy orbs, avoids enemies of multiple types, and receives AI-generated hints based on performance.
frontend/src/pages/games/EnemiesPlatform: A platformer game where flying enemies act as moving platforms; the player must hop across them to reach a goal, with levels increasing enemy count and a game-over on enemy contact.
frontend/src/pages/games/EnemyControlsCa: A 2D game where the camera follows a bouncing enemy instead of the player, forcing the player to collect coins and reach a goal while avoiding the enemy despite the disorienting camera.
frontend/src/pages/games/EscapeRoomUnive: A timed escape-room puzzle game with multiple themed rooms where the player clicks to find hidden items, unlocking subsequent rooms and scoring points before a 180-second countdown expires.
frontend/src/pages/games/EverythingBreak: A platformer where every platform begins breaking immediately after the player lands on it, requiring quick movement to reach the goal before platforms disappear.
frontend/src/pages/games/EverythingIsBut: A canvas game where the player navigates a field of clickable buttons that each trigger random effects (teleport, score changes, reveal goal), requiring the player to find and reach a hidden goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/FamousPlaces.ts: A quiz game where players identify the location of famous world landmarks from multiple-choice options, awarding 10 points per correct answer and tracking a high score.
frontend/src/pages/games/FinalBoss.tsx: A canvas-based tower-defense game where the player places traps (spike, fire, arrow) to stop waves of heroes from reaching and damaging the boss, with increasing difficulty per wave.
frontend/src/pages/games/FloorIsLiar.tsx: A canvas platformer where platforms display 'SAFE' or 'DANGER' labels that may lie; landing on an actually-unsafe platform ends the game, and reaching the goal advances the level.
frontend/src/pages/games/ForestNight.tsx: A top-down game where the player navigates a dark forest using arrow keys to collect coins within a limited visibility radius before a 90-second timer expires.
frontend/src/pages/games/GadgetCombat.ts: A top-down game where the player uses selectable gadgets (grapple, gravity, drone, shield) with cooldowns to stun or capture enemies that move toward the player, ending if any enemy makes contact.
frontend/src/pages/games/GlitchWorldEsca: A canvas-based platformer game where the player navigates platforms by toggling 'glitch mode' (G key) to switch which platforms are solid, with arrow/WASD controls and a fall-detection game-over condition.
frontend/src/pages/games/GrandmaSecretAr: A canvas-based mini-game collection with three games (whack-a-mole, catch cookies, memory cards) selectable from a menu, featuring a 'Grandma' character that displays encouraging messages.
frontend/src/pages/games/InventoryIsEnem: A canvas-based top-down game where the player collects items that slow movement and drain health based on total inventory weight, needing to reach a goal while avoiding enemies.
frontend/src/pages/games/LiesAndTruths.t: A canvas-based platformer where the player must navigate safe and unsafe platforms while receiving hints that may be true or false, advancing through levels by reaching the goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/MemoryMatch.tsx: A React-based memory card matching game using emoji pairs on a grid that grows with each level, tracking score and moves with match/mismatch flip animations.
A puzzle game where players click on rooms in a grid and solve color, pattern, or sequence challenges to earn points. All rooms solved triggers game over and high score tracking.
frontend/src/pages/games/MonsterMaze.tsx: A canvas-based maze game where the player navigates with arrow/WASD keys to reach an exit while avoiding three randomly moving monsters. Collision with a monster ends the game; reaching the exit awards bonus points.
frontend/src/pages/games/MoveWhenBlink.t: A canvas game where the player can only move while a 'blink' state is active (triggered by spacebar), and must avoid bouncing enemies to reach a goal. Collisions outside the blink window end the game.
frontend/src/pages/games/NumberRunner.ts: A lane-based runner game where math-problem obstacles scroll toward the player, who must answer correctly to remove them or face game over. Speed increases as score grows and lane switching is done with arrow keys.
frontend/src/pages/games/OneButtonHero.t: A single-button canvas game where tap, hold, or long-hold of the spacebar triggers jump, dash, or shield actions to avoid incoming obstacles. Action cooldowns and gravity are managed via a game loop with delta time.
frontend/src/pages/games/OneRoomInfinite: A canvas-based mini-game collection that randomly cycles through four mini-games (dodge projectiles, collect coins, memory sequence, platformer) in a single room, tracking score and high score across rounds.
frontend/src/pages/games/PacMan.tsx: A Pac-Man clone rendered on a 20x20 grid using React state and refs, featuring maze walls, pellet collection, two ghosts, lives system, and keyboard controls.
frontend/src/pages/games/PauseMechanic.t: A canvas game where the player collects coins while avoiding hazards, with a pause mechanic (P key) that triggers random effects like spawning items, rewinding position, or teleporting.
frontend/src/pages/games/PoliceBuddyChas: A lane-based arcade game where the player moves a police character left and right to catch falling criminals before they escape, with increasing speed as score grows.
frontend/src/pages/games/PumpkinSmash.ts: A timed click-to-smash game where bouncing pumpkin emojis are drawn on a canvas and the player must click them to score points within a 30-second countdown.
frontend/src/pages/games/ReverseProgress: A canvas-based platformer game where the player starts with all abilities (double jump, dash, shield, slow time) and loses one per level, making the game progressively harder. Enemies and platforms are generated per level, and the player must reach a goal position.
frontend/src/pages/games/ScreenIsEnemy.t: A canvas game where the player collects coins while the screen itself acts as an enemy by applying random disorienting effects (shake, shrink, split, rotate) that damage the player's health over time.
frontend/src/pages/games/ShapeShiftingWo: A React-state-driven game where the player shifts between four forms (human, bird, fish, mouse) using number keys to bypass different obstacle types and collect items across escalating levels.
frontend/src/pages/games/SlimeEvolutionA: A canvas arena game where the player controls a slime that can temporarily transform into different forms (magnet, explosive, giant) to interact with spawning enemies of matching types.
frontend/src/pages/games/SoundBasedWorld: A canvas game where the player navigates a dark world toward a goal, with movement emitting expanding sound waves that visually reveal nearby obstacles and the environment.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpaceInvaders.t: A Space Invaders game component using React refs and requestAnimationFrame for a game loop, featuring player movement, shooting, enemy waves, and collision detection on a 600x500 canvas-like div.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpaceStationLif: A space station life-simulation game where the player picks a role (engineer, explorer, trader), manages energy/materials/credits resources over time, and responds to random events like meteors and alien encounters.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpeedIsHealth.t: A canvas-based game where the player must keep moving to maintain health, collecting coins while avoiding obstacles, with health decreasing when the player moves slowly and increasing when moving fast.
frontend/src/pages/games/SpiderWebPuzzle: A puzzle game where players click pairs of connected nodes to remove edges from a randomly generated graph, with the goal of disconnecting all nodes across multiple levels.
frontend/src/pages/games/SuperpowerTrain: A side-scrolling game where the player navigates a character using arrow keys, avoids enemies and walls, and collects targets while unlocking new powers (strength, speed, flight, shield) as the score increases.
frontend/src/pages/games/SuperSpeedyRace: A three-lane endless racer game where the player uses arrow keys to dodge obstacles that scroll downward at increasing speed, scoring points for each obstacle passed.
frontend/src/pages/games/Tetris.tsx: A fully functional Tetris implementation using a canvas-like board rendered in React, supporting all standard tetrominoes, rotation, line clearing, leveling, and high score tracking via requestAnimationFrame-based game loop.
frontend/src/pages/games/ThemeParkBuilde: A theme park management game where the player spends cash to place rides on a grid, earning income over time while managing visitor happiness to avoid a game-over condition.
frontend/src/pages/games/TicTacToe.tsx: A Tic-Tac-Toe game supporting both player-vs-player and player-vs-AI modes, where the AI uses basic heuristics (win, block, center, corners) with a short thinking delay.
frontend/src/pages/games/TimeControlAdve: An action game where the player moves around a field, collecting coins and avoiding enemies and projectiles, with time-manipulation powers (slow, freeze, rewind) managed via a requestAnimationFrame game loop.
frontend/src/pages/games/TimeLoopPizzaDe: A canvas-based game where the player delivers pizzas and removes obstacles within a 60-second time loop that resets on expiry, tracking score and loop count.
frontend/src/pages/games/TinyHeroGiantWo: A canvas-based platformer where a tiny player navigates a giant-scale world with oversized furniture objects, collecting coins and reaching a goal.
frontend/src/pages/games/TutorialIsVilla: A canvas game where the in-game tutorial actively works against the player by spawning traps and fake harmful coins while displaying misleading instructions.
frontend/src/pages/games/WordWizard.tsx: A timed word-unscrambling game where players select scrambled letters to form the correct word within 90 seconds, scoring points based on word length.
frontend/src/pages/games/YoureLateAlways: A canvas-based survival game where the player navigates a chaotic scene filled with bouncing projectiles, fires, and explosions that scale in difficulty with each level.
frontend/src/pages/GamesHub.tsx: A games hub page that displays a grid of available games (arcade, racing, puzzle, educational, etc.) with icons, descriptions, difficulty badges, and lock/unlock logic based on trial game access.
frontend/src/pages/GamesModule.tsx: A games module page that lists five sample games (puzzle, educational, creative, action, logic) with progress bars and high scores, organized into tabbed categories for filtering.
frontend/src/pages/GreenScreenFunPage.ts: A green screen fun page where users can upload a photo or use their camera, select a cartoon background scene, and download a composite image with their photo overlaid on the chosen scene.
frontend/src/pages/InteractiveShortsPage: A branching interactive story page where users select a story and make choices that navigate between scenes, with support for multiple endings and a restart option.
frontend/src/pages/JokesGenerator.tsx: A client-side jokes generator component with hardcoded jokes across multiple categories, supporting random joke display, favorites, sharing, and audio playback via toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/JokesPage.tsx: A jokes browsing and submission page that fetches jokes from the backend via React Query hooks, allowing users to filter by category, rate jokes, toggle favorites, and submit new jokes.
frontend/src/pages/KaraokeModePage.tsx: A karaoke page that lets users select from a list of children's songs and displays scrolling lyrics line-by-line in sync with a timed interval, with vocal and music volume sliders.
frontend/src/pages/LearnHubPage.tsx: A learning hub page that organizes educational content into categories (Reading, Science, Arts, Discovery) with lesson lists, progress tracking, and dedicated activity sub-components for each category.
frontend/src/pages/MusicRemixPage.tsx: A music remix studio page that lets users adjust tempo, pitch, volume, reverb, and delay sliders, preview audio via the Web Audio API, and save remix configurations to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ParentalControl.tsx: A parental controls page with tabs for screen time limits, content filtering, and (admin-only) user approval management, using backend queries to list and update approval statuses.
frontend/src/pages/PreLoginExperiencePag: A pre-login landing page that presents the app's features, prompts users to sign in via Internet Identity, and offers a trial games option for unauthenticated visitors.
A profile customization page where users can set their name, age, avatar emoji, and color theme, loading existing profile data from the backend and saving updates via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/RewardsAchievements.t: A static rewards and achievements page displaying the user's total points, level, progress toward achievements, unlocked badges, and daily challenges with progress bars.
frontend/src/pages/RewardsPage.tsx: Displays a user's rewards dashboard including total score, games played, achievements, badge collection, and virtual pet level, with celebration animations triggered on badge clicks.
frontend/src/pages/ScaryHub.tsx: A Halloween-themed hub page listing spooky mini-games (Monster Maze, Spider Web Puzzle, Pumpkin Smash) with a dark animated background, sound toggle, and surprise pop-up feature.
frontend/src/pages/SeasonalEventsPage.ts: Shows season-appropriate themed activities, decorations, and stories (Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter) with tabbed navigation, activity completion tracking, and a story reader dialog.
frontend/src/pages/SmartHubPage.tsx: A personalized activity recommendation hub that surfaces a daily pick, suggested activities, and recently played items based on the day of the week and stored user data.
frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx: An interactive canvas-based spin wheel that awards trophies or points to the user, enforces a cooldown between spins via a backend actor call, and maintains a local spin history.
frontend/src/pages/StickerCreatorPage.ts: A canvas-based sticker drawing page where users can draw with a brush or eraser, set colors and sizes, name their sticker, and submit it for approval. It also displays a gallery of already-approved stickers fetched via a query hook.
frontend/src/pages/StoryBuilderPage.tsx: A drag-and-drop story builder page that lets authenticated users compose multi-scene stories with characters, props, and text bubbles, saving projects to localStorage via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGenerator.tsx: A UI-only video generator page with template selection, character picking, sticker addition, and duration controls, currently showing a placeholder canvas preview without real video generation.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGeneratorPage.ts: A more functional video generator page that takes a title, story text, character, and background, generates animation frames, and plays them back on an HTML5 canvas with simple character movement and text overlays.
frontend/src/pages/VideoHubPage.tsx: A curated video hub page listing age-filtered educational YouTube channels and craft/DIY projects, with detail views that link out to external channels or display craft instructions.
frontend/src/pages/VirtualPetHubPage.tsx: A React page for managing a virtual pet hub, allowing users to create/name a pet, equip accessories, add decorations, and choose a home style, with data persisted via custom query hooks.
frontend/src/utils/avatarConfig.ts: Provides utility functions to get a default avatar configuration and merge a partial user avatar config with defaults.
frontend/src/utils/craftVideoResolver.ts: An empty utility file with no current implementation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values via sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens (including neon and sidebar palettes), border radii, and neon box-shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the Kids Fun App project, documenting existing features, known issues, and pending action requests related to the Spin the Wheel cooldown timer and points/trophy routing logic.
